scope: Draft-relevant Passion Guillotine I players with Yahoo injury/status flags, top-120 ADP injury/discipline news, and major Week 1 role changes surfaced by Yahoo, FantasyPros, NBC Rotoworld, NFL.com, ESPN-linked reports, CBS, and team/beat reports.

sources.name: Yahoo fantasy training camp injury tracker
FantasyPros player news and injury updates

overrides.name: Christian McCaffrey
overrides.riskTags: Q; tightness/returning to team drills; 15 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Still elite, but not a totally clean first-round safety pick. Treat the return-to-practice news as positive, then require a small guillotine discount.
overrides.jeffNote: Returned to team work after unspecified tightness and would likely play in a real game, but prior soft-tissue history still matters in Week 1 survival.

overrides.name: Puka Nacua
overrides.riskTags: Q; Groin/psoas; possible short suspension risk; 15 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Elite WR, but not a normal first-round safety pick until the practice and discipline questions clear. Prefer safer first-round anchors unless he slides.
overrides.jeffNote: Market still prices him around pick 5, but guillotine needs an uncertainty discount for groin/psoas plus possible short suspension risk. Do not pay #2 overall.

overrides.name: Ashton Jeanty
overrides.riskTags: Q; low ankle sprain; Week 1 uncertain; 14 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Exciting talent, but the ankle makes him a dangerous early anchor. Only draft if he slips well past the healthy-player price.
overrides.jeffNote: Reports frame the ankle as more low than high and not long-term, but Week 1 uncertainty plus pick-14 cost is poor guillotine arbitrage.

overrides.name: Jeremiyah Love
overrides.riskTags: Q; high ankle sprain; out of practice this week; Week 1 uncertain; 15 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: High-ankle sprains can linger. Do not use him as an early Week 1 floor piece.
overrides.jeffNote: The ADP dip is explained by injury, not hidden value. Needs a real discount and a roster that already has stable starters.

overrides.name: Breece Hall
overrides.riskTags: Q; Groin; expected Week 1 but recent soft-tissue injury; 15 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Good player, but make sure the groin news stays positive before treating him as a normal starter.
overrides.jeffNote: Current reports are optimistic for Week 1, so this is a modest discount rather than a full fade.

overrides.name: Josh Jacobs
overrides.riskTags: Q; Groin; possible discipline/suspension review; 14 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Name value is stronger than the safety profile right now. Do not click him as a normal RB anchor.
overrides.jeffNote: Groin return-to-practice news helps, but unresolved discipline risk and RB age/workload make him a risky RB2 for guillotine.

overrides.name: Malik Nabers
overrides.riskTags: Q; ACL/meniscus recovery; returned to team drills; contact/ramp pending; 14 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Trending better, but ACL recovery is not the same as a clean Week 1 workload. Better as a discount than as a reach.
overrides.jeffNote: Positive practice report softens the fade, but the early-season ramp and ADP still require a guillotine discount.

overrides.name: Tyler Warren
overrides.riskTags: Q; adductor/groin; Week 1 optimism but practice risk
overrides.joannaNote: At TE, do not pay for uncertainty unless the discount is clear.
overrides.jeffNote: Could be ready quickly, but adductor/groin tags are exactly the type of soft-tissue risk to break ties against.

overrides.name: George Kittle
overrides.riskTags: Q; Achilles; activated from PUP; ramp/age risk; 14 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Activation is good news, but an Achilles ramp for an older TE is not a normal starter profile.
overrides.jeffNote: Week 1 hope is real, but ADP must fall because snap/route ramp and reinjury risk matter more in guillotine.

overrides.name: Chuba Hubbard
overrides.riskTags: Q; Hamstring; week-to-week; backfield role pressure
overrides.joannaNote: Hamstring plus backfield uncertainty means he is not a boring-safe pick.
overrides.jeffNote: The injury opened the door for Jonathon Brooks; take only if the market discount reflects the role risk.

overrides.name: Patrick Mahomes
overrides.riskTags: Q; ACL/LCL recovery; Week 1 not guaranteed; one-QB guillotine league
overrides.joannaNote: Do not spend a meaningful pick on a QB with Week 1 knee uncertainty in this format.
overrides.jeffNote: Even if he plays, one-QB replacement value and knee ramp make the ADP difficult to justify.

overrides.name: Alvin Kamara
overrides.riskTags: Q; MCL; expected out at least a month; 12 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Not a Week 1 survival pick. Avoid unless extremely late and clearly a stash.
overrides.jeffNote: Expected multi-week absence makes him a poor guillotine draft asset before waivers reshape the league.

overrides.name: Jordyn Tyson
overrides.riskTags: D; Hamstring; expected to miss about two months; 11 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Do not draft for Week 1 survival. This is a stash profile, not a starter.
overrides.jeffNote: NFL.com reported an approximately two-month absence; ADP has to crater before he becomes rational.

overrides.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
overrides.riskTags: 15 projected games; Kamara injury may support early workload
overrides.joannaNote: This is the kind of practical role boost that matters. Stronger target if the price stays in the fourth-round area.
overrides.jeffNote: Kamara's MCL absence improves early-season workload path; keep the usual RB volatility, but this is positive news arbitrage.

overrides.name: Chris Olave
overrides.riskTags: 15 projected games; Saints injuries may concentrate targets but offense is fragile
overrides.joannaNote: More target opportunity is good, but do not ignore the offense around him.
overrides.jeffNote: Tyson/Kamara injuries can push volume toward Olave while also lowering touchdown environment.

overrides.name: Mike Washington Jr.
overrides.joannaNote: Only a late contingency pick. He matters if Jeanty is limited.
overrides.jeffNote: Watch Raiders practice reports; he is a late-round leverage option if the room underreacts to Jeanty's ankle.

overrides.name: MarShawn Lloyd
overrides.riskTags: Jacobs groin/discipline contingency; own health history; 4 projected games
overrides.joannaNote: Only late. He is a contingency, not a starter you can trust on draft night.
overrides.jeffNote: Useful leverage if Jacobs' news worsens, but his own durability and low projection keep the price capped.
